acceptance.expected: docker build + docker run: /readyz 200 with a valid bundle, 503 without
acceptance.actual: Image built from the repo root (docker build -f connectors/demo/Dockerfile .), kit via path source. docker_smoke.sh: bundle built by gxg-policy build from fixtures/grants/ with a throw-away key -> /readyz 200 {"status":"ready"}; no bundle -> 503; bundle under another key -> 503. In-process: missing / flipped byte / foreign key -> 503 without reasons in the body; reload on file change; a broken update keeps the previous bundle Cycle 2: without a valid bundle every tool call is refused with the same temporarily_unavailable body (GR-12). Cycle 3: docker_smoke.sh also makes a tools/call on the image and finds its JSON audit line on the container's stdout (docker logs).

acceptance.expected: Official MCP SDK client lists 3 tools (no propose); input/output schemas equal the files
acceptance.actual: mcp 2.3.0 ClientSession over Streamable HTTP (httpx2 ASGITransport): exactly demo.boards.list, demo.notes.search, demo.note.get; inputSchema/outputSchema equal the files named in gxg-manifest.yaml (search output = schemas/search-result.schema.json); results validate against them; errors validate against error.schema.json and are duplicated in content (MCC-04/05); tool timeouts equal manifest limits

acceptance.expected: boards.list: t-alpha:reader = a-public, a-sales; t-alpha:nobody = []; t-beta:reader = b-public, b-ops
acceptance.actual: Exactly as expected (plus t-alpha:actor = a-public); nobody does not reach the backend (allowed() empty); unknown tenant -> [] Cycle 2: nobody / unknown tenant / board_ids [] make no backend call at all (sum of counters 0, also with index down).

acceptance.expected: search over all 5 boards: t-alpha:reader sees only a-public/a-sales; items, next_cursor, partial_reasons unchanged after adding matching notes to a-secret
acceptance.actual: Every page (limit 7, cursor chain) only a-public/a-sales, all matching notes, no overlaps; after adding matching notes to a-secret all pages are identical. GR-17: a-secret, a mixed list, another tenant's board and a non-existent board give the same not_found. GR-16: a backend that returns extra notes leaks nothing (check() per item). Tenants do not mix (same injection text in both) Cycle 3: the cursor is checked also for an empty board set: {board_ids: [], cursor: 'garbage'} and a reader's cursor used by nobody -> invalid_input.

acceptance.expected: note.get of an a-secret note and of a t-beta note by t-alpha:reader -> not_found, byte-identical to a non-existent note
acceptance.actual: Three replies serialized byte-identical: {code: not_found, message: 'not found', retryable: false}; the board comes from the backend, a board_id argument is ignored; actor gets not_found for an existing a-sales note Cycle 2: also without a bundle: hidden, public and missing ids give one identical temporarily_unavailable body for nobody, reader and an unknown tenant.

acceptance.expected: tenant_id/agent_id in arguments, X-Tenant-Id/X-Forwarded-User headers, _meta do not change the result
acceptance.actual: For all three tools (incl. a cross-tenant note.get) the full CallToolResult with spoofed arguments, headers and _meta equals the plain one. Extra arguments are ignored (input schemas allow them), identity comes only from the verified header

acceptance.expected: no identity, foreign issuer, expired or replayed -> unauthenticated, backend counter = 0
acceptance.actual: Also other audience, principal outside its tenant and a malformed token; every tool returns {code: unauthenticated, message: 'token rejected', retryable: false}; sum of backend calls = 0. Production profile (no verifier yet) refuses every call

acceptance.expected: POST /_test/index/fail -> result via scan (partial_reasons empty, method marker in logs); valid empty index result -> scan counter 0
acceptance.actual: Both temporarily_unavailable and timeout_before_start: scan result equals the index result, partial_reasons [], audit line method=scan, index=1/scan=1; repair -> method=index, scan 0. Empty result: index only, scan 0. Other index errors (internal_error) do not fall back. Scan out of time -> partial_reasons [source_timeout], complete false. Scan delay 2 s by default Cycle 3: the audit lines (with the method marker) reach stdout of the real process: child-process test of the real main() and docker_smoke.sh on the image.

acceptance.expected: after 100 calls of all tools no DEMO_PROVIDER_TOKEN or its value in logs and responses, no note texts in logs
acceptance.actual: 100 calls (3 tools, 3 principals, ok and not_found) with DEMO_PROVIDER_TOKEN=demo-secret-<random> in the process env; every logger at INFO captured: neither the name nor the value appear; no note bodies/titles, queries or JWTs in logs; 100 audit lines with request_id, tenant, principal, tool, grant_id, outcome, duration_ms Cycle 2: an unexpected exception carrying a secret in its text returns internal_error without it; the text is in neither the response nor the logs. Cycle 3: internal_error adds the exception class to the audit line; stack frames go to stderr as file:line in function only (no message, no source lines, no arguments).

acceptance.expected: search for the prompt-injection note returns it as data; no records in fake provider and Approval Service journals
acceptance.actual: The note is returned as an excerpt; backend calls are reads only (boards, index); no propose tool exists. In M3 the fake provider and Approval Service do not exist (stage C), so their journals are empty by construction; root pytest run forbids every TCP socket, so no outbound call is possible

acceptance.expected: production profile with the test issuer or DEMO_TEST_CONTROLS=1 does not start (exit != 0)
acceptance.actual: python -m demo_connector exits 2 (startup_refused) for DEMO_TEST_ISSUER_KEY or DEMO_TEST_CONTROLS=1 with GXG_PROFILE unset/production/prod; the production image exits 2 likewise and has no testctl module Cycle 3: test controls listen on 127.0.0.1:8090 only with DEMO_TEST_CONTROLS=1, MCP on 0.0.0.0:8080 (configs() asserted, test-controls app driven).

known_limits: Outside GXG_PROFILE=test the connector has no identity verifier: the ContextForge variant-C verifier (ADR-0001) is not in the kit yet, so every tool call is unauthenticated (fail closed). Needed before M5
AC-M3-10 names journals of the fake provider and Approval Service; neither exists in M3 (stage C)
DEMO_PROVIDER_TOKEN is not read by the M3 connector (no provider before M8); AC-M3-09 checks that the value in the process environment never leaks
Spec lists fixtures/grants/t-alpha.yaml; gxg-policy reads a root with tenants/ and platform/, so tests and smoke assemble a temporary root
Network restriction 'only from ContextForge' (SEC-04) and internal port 8081 are out of M3 scope
The Dockerfile takes an optional BuildKit secret ca-bundle for a TLS-intercepting proxy (used only in the sandbox build, not in CI)
